interface AuthenticatedRouteRouteChildren {
  AuthenticatedArquivoRoute: typeof AuthenticatedArquivoRoute
  AuthenticatedBriefsRoute: typeof AuthenticatedBriefsRoute
  AuthenticatedCustosRoute: typeof AuthenticatedCustosRoute
  AuthenticatedDefinicoesRoute: typeof AuthenticatedDefinicoesRoute
  AuthenticatedEdicaoWebRoute: typeof AuthenticatedEdicaoWebRoute
  AuthenticatedEdicoesPassadasRoute: typeof AuthenticatedEdicoesPassadasRoute
  AuthenticatedEmailsRoute: typeof AuthenticatedEmailsRoute
  AuthenticatedFerramentasRoute: typeof AuthenticatedFerramentasRoute
  AuthenticatedIndexRoute: typeof AuthenticatedIndexRoute
  AuthenticatedPreVisualizarNumeroRoute: typeof AuthenticatedPreVisualizarNumeroRoute
  AuthenticatedPreVisualizarBriefSlugRoute: typeof AuthenticatedPreVisualizarBriefSlugRoute
}

const AuthenticatedRouteRouteChildren: AuthenticatedRouteRouteChildren = {
  AuthenticatedArquivoRoute: AuthenticatedArquivoRoute,
  AuthenticatedBriefsRoute: AuthenticatedBriefsRoute,
  AuthenticatedCustosRoute: AuthenticatedCustosRoute,
  AuthenticatedDefinicoesRoute: AuthenticatedDefinicoesRoute,
  AuthenticatedEdicaoWebRoute: AuthenticatedEdicaoWebRoute,
  AuthenticatedEdicoesPassadasRoute: AuthenticatedEdicoesPassadasRoute,
  AuthenticatedEmailsRoute: AuthenticatedEmailsRoute,
  AuthenticatedFerramentasRoute: AuthenticatedFerramentasRoute,
  AuthenticatedIndexRoute: AuthenticatedIndexRoute,
  AuthenticatedPreVisualizarNumeroRoute: AuthenticatedPreVisualizarNumeroRoute,
  AuthenticatedPreVisualizarBriefSlugRoute:
    AuthenticatedPreVisualizarBriefSlugRoute,
}

const AuthenticatedRouteRouteWithChildren =
  AuthenticatedRouteRoute._addFileChildren(AuthenticatedRouteRouteChildren)

const rootRouteChildren: RootRouteChildren = {
  AuthenticatedRouteRoute: AuthenticatedRouteRouteWithChildren,
  NumeroRoute: NumeroRoute,
  AuthRoute: AuthRoute,
  SitemapDotxmlRoute: SitemapDotxmlRoute,
  SubscricaoRoute: SubscricaoRoute,
  BriefSlugRoute: BriefSlugRoute,
  EdicoesNumeroRoute: EdicoesNumeroRoute,
  EdicoesIndexRoute: EdicoesIndexRoute,
  PreviewBriefDestaqueRoute: PreviewBriefDestaqueRoute,
  PreviewBriefHubRoute: PreviewBriefHubRoute,
  PreviewBriefRadarRoute: PreviewBriefRadarRoute,
  PreviewBriefReverLeiturasRoute: PreviewBriefReverLeiturasRoute,
  ApiPublicHooksCuradoriaFerramentasRoute:
    ApiPublicHooksCuradoriaFerramentasRoute,
  ApiPublicHooksCuradoriaRssRoute: ApiPublicHooksCuradoriaRssRoute,
  ApiPublicHooksEgoiSubscricaoRoute: ApiPublicHooksEgoiSubscricaoRoute,
  ApiPublicHooksEmailNewsletterRoute: ApiPublicHooksEmailNewsletterRoute,
  ApiPublicHooksEnviarAgendadosRoute: ApiPublicHooksEnviarAgendadosRoute,
  ApiPublicHooksReprocessarEmailsRoute: ApiPublicHooksReprocessarEmailsRoute,
  ApiPublicHooksRetomarSubscricoesRoute: ApiPublicHooksRetomarSubscricoesRoute,
  ApiPublicHooksSincronizarPodcastRoute: ApiPublicHooksSincronizarPodcastRoute,
  ApiPublicHooksUnsubscribeRoute: ApiPublicHooksUnsubscribeRoute,
  ApiPublicImagemSplatRoute: ApiPublicImagemSplatRoute,
}
export const routeTree = rootRouteImport
  ._addFileChildren(rootRouteChildren)
  ._addFileTypes<FileRouteTypes>()

  interface Register {
    ssr: true
